metaTitle: Dessert Cups for Cultural & Religious Celebrations
metaDescription: Hand-layered dessert cups and mini shots for cultural and religious celebrations and big family gatherings, made fresh in Hamilton with Saturday GTA delivery.
h1: Dessert cups for cultural and religious celebrations
intro: Religious holidays, cultural festivals, an anniversary, a naming ceremony: the days when the whole family ends up around one table. We make hand-layered dessert cups and mini dessert shots for cultural and religious celebrations like these. Every cup is made fresh in Hamilton, Ontario, the morning of pickup or delivery.

sections.heading: You bring the traditions. We bring the cups.
sections.body:
Every family celebrates in its own way, and you know your table better than we do. Our part is the cups: each one layered by hand, each one its own portion, so there's nothing to slice or plate once the greetings and photos are done.

Set them out on a dessert table after a big meal, or hand them round while everyone is still catching up.

sections.heading: Big family, big table: why the 96 fits
sections.body:
When the guest list spans three or four generations, the 96 is the pack built for it. It comes with a presentation tray, a custom label option and event-day pickup. It also has room for up to 16 flavours, so the limit is the menu, not the box. Each flavour needs at least 6 cups, and Classic and Premium mix freely. Not sure how many? See the [cups-per-guest guide](/packages).

For a smaller gathering, the 48 is our most popular pack, with priority preparation and a free flavour recommendation: [start a 48](/order?pack=48&event=cultural). The 24 holds up to 4 flavours.

sections.heading: Planning around the calendar
sections.body:
Standard orders need at least 48 hours' notice; anything shorter is urgent, subject to availability, with no guarantee. Count back 48 hours from when you need the cups and send your request before then. Holiday weeks are busy for hosts, though, so the moment your date is settled is a good time to send it. Earlier gives everyone more breathing room.

Holidays don't always land on a weekend. [Saturday delivery across the GTA](/dessert-cups-gta) suits families hosting on the nearest Saturday; the fee depends on your location, and we quote it after we confirm your order. [Free pickup in Hamilton](/dessert-cups-hamilton) is by arrangement, and we share the location once your order is confirmed. Whatever day your celebration falls on, put your date in your request and we'll confirm within the day whether it works.

Some celebrations follow a lunar calendar, and some depend on a moon sighting, so the exact day may not be certain until close to the date. If that's your situation, mention it in your notes.

sections.heading: Matching the cups to your colours
sections.body:
Plenty of celebrations come with their own colours, and you'll know which ones matter for yours. Here's how the flavours group by colour family, so you can build a box that suits your table:

- Warm golds and oranges: [Mango Dream](/menu/mango-dream) (orange and pale yellow), [Biscoff Bliss](/menu/biscoff-bliss) (caramel and amber), and the gold middle layer of [Dubai Chocolate](/menu/dubai-chocolate).
- Reds and pinks: [Strawberry Fields](/menu/strawberry-fields) (red and blush pink).
- Greens: Dubai Chocolate again (pale green).
- Deep violet: [Blueberry Haze](/menu/blueberry-haze) (violet and lilac).
- Rich browns: [Ferrero Royale](/menu/ferrero-royale) (dark chocolate), [Kinder Bueno](/menu/kinder-bueno) (milk chocolate) and [Tiramisu](/menu/tiramisu) (cocoa).

Some Dubai Chocolate cups are finished with rose petals. If that detail matters to you, mention it in your request. For what each cup looks like, the [events page](/events) has the full colour guide, and [the menu](/menu) lists every layer, bottom to top.

sections.heading: One way to fill a 96
sections.body:
Here is a worked example, not a recipe for any particular holiday: a 96 of Dessert Cups split into 24 Mango Dream, 24 Strawberry Fields, 12 Blueberry Haze, 12 Biscoff Bliss, 12 Kinder Bueno and 12 Dubai Chocolate. That's six flavours, each well above the 6-cup minimum, with 60 Classic cups and 36 Premium.

Because each cup is priced by its own tier, the estimated total for that box is $424 before delivery. The same split in Mini Shots comes to $186. Three-quarters of the cups are flavours that aren't flagged for tree nuts, though every cup is made in the same kitchen, so cross-contact with nuts is possible (more on that below).

To try your own split, [start a 96 of Dessert Cups](/order?pack=96&size=5oz&event=cultural). The order form adds up your mix as you go; any delivery fee is quoted after we confirm.

sections.heading: Nuts, dairy and dietary rules
sections.body:
Every cup contains dairy. Kinder Bueno, Ferrero Royale and Dubai Chocolate contain tree nuts. If some guests avoid nuts, you can lean your box toward Mango Dream, Strawberry Fields, Blueberry Haze and Biscoff Bliss, which aren't flagged for tree nuts. That works for preference, not for an allergy. Every cup is made in the same kitchen, so cross-contact with nuts is possible in any flavour.

Gluten, eggs and dietary rules such as halal or kosher are covered in the questions below. If any of them matters for your table, or a guest has a severe allergy, message us on Instagram at @dessertshot.ca before you order.

sections.heading: What happens after you send your request
sections.body:
You order by sending a request, and there's no online payment. Here is how it goes:

1. You send the request: date, pack, size, flavours, pickup or delivery, and any notes. Notes are the place for your ideas for the 96's custom label option, a question about ingredients if your celebration follows dietary rules, or a heads-up that your date depends on the calendar or a moon sighting.
2. We confirm within the day.
3. If you chose delivery, we quote the fee after we confirm. If you chose pickup, it's by arrangement, and we share the pickup location in Hamilton once your order is confirmed.
4. Your cups are made fresh the morning of pickup or delivery.

Still deciding? The [dessert cup FAQ](/faq) covers flavours per pack, lead times and delivery. The [events page](/events) covers weddings, showers, birthdays and other occasions.

faqs.q: Are your dessert cups halal, kosher, vegetarian or alcohol-free?
faqs.a: We don't claim that any flavour is halal, kosher, vegetarian or alcohol-free. If your celebration follows dietary rules, message us on Instagram at @dessertshot.ca before you order and tell us which flavours you're considering. The menu shows each cup's layers, not every ingredient inside them, so please ask rather than rely on it.

faqs.q: Are the cups gluten-free and eggless?
faqs.a: {{dietaryClaim}} Every cup also contains dairy. If a guest needs to avoid gluten or eggs for medical reasons, or has a severe allergy, message us before you order.

faqs.q: Can you help us choose flavours?
faqs.a: A free flavour recommendation comes with the 48. For any pack, the colour guide and the worked 96 above are a good place to start, and the menu has the layer-by-layer detail.

faqs.q: Can we pick up on the day of the celebration?
faqs.a: The 96 comes with event-day pickup, and every cup is made fresh the morning of pickup. For any pack, put your date in your request and we'll confirm within the day whether it works. Pickup is free in Hamilton, by arrangement, and we share the location once your order is confirmed.

faqs.q: What if we need more than a 96?
faqs.a: A 96 holds up to 16 flavours, with at least 6 cups of each. If your gathering needs more cups on the same date, say so in your request and we'll confirm what's possible within the day.
